shortDescription: Tuleap is an enterprise open source Application Lifecycle Management platform. Agile planning, requirements, test management, document management, version control, CI/CD integration.
longDescription:
## What it is

Tuleap is an enterprise open source ALM (Application Lifecycle Management) platform. Agile planning, requirements management, test management, document management, version control, CI/CD integration, and project dashboards.

## Why we recommend it

If you need a full ALM suite (not just issue tracking), Tuleap is the most complete open source option. It's used by Airbus, Thales, and other large enterprises for regulated industries.

## When to use it

- Enterprises with complex regulated workflows
- Companies needing requirements + tests + agile in one tool
- Replacing Jira + Confluence + Zephyr
- Open source projects that want a public ALM
installInstructions:
**Docker (Community Edition):**
```
docker run -d --name tuleap -p 80:80 -p 22:22 enalean/tuleap-community-edition
```

**Enterprise:** Enalean offers enterprise support and SaaS.
